turns.query: Our functional currency is SGD. We acquired USD 1,000 of Apple shares on 13/11/2025 at USD/SGD spot rate of 1.30. We sold all 300 shares for USD 1,100 at a USD/SGD spot rate of 1.31 dated 16/12/2025. Prepare the journal entries.

priorCommitted.title: Initial Acquisition of Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares
priorCommitted.summary: Acquisition of USD 1,000 translated at 1 USD = SGD 1.30

lines.accountName: Financial Asset at FVTPL (Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares)
lines.lineExplanation: Initial fair value recognition under SFRS(I) 9 §5.1.1 translated at spot rate of 1 USD = SGD 1.30.
Disbursement of USD 1,000 translated at transaction spot rate.

citations.title: Financial Instruments - Initial Measurement
citations.text: At initial recognition, an entity measures a financial asset or financial liability at fair value. For an item not measured at fair value through profit or loss, directly attributable transaction costs are added to the initial fair value of a financial asset (and deducted for a financial liability). The separate trade-receivable expedient in paragraph 5.1.3 may apply where its conditions are met.

citations.title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates - Initial Spot Rate
citations.text: A foreign currency transaction shall be recorded, on initial recognition in the functional currency, by applying the spot exchange rate at the transaction date.

rationalePoints: Under SFRS(I) 9 §5.1.1: Financial assets at FVTPL are initially recognized at fair value.
Under SFRS(I) 1-21 §21: A foreign currency transaction is recorded on initial recognition in functional currency using the spot exchange rate (1 USD = SGD 1.30).
